title: The Hidden Digit Pattern in the 9 Times Table
description: A step-by-step look at the multiply-by-10-then-subtract shortcut, and the digit-sum pattern it always produces.
narration_lines: There's a hidden pattern in the 9 times table.
Then subtract the original number. 70 minus 7 is 63.
9 times 7 is 63, and 6 plus 3 makes 9. That always happens.

params.footnote: notice: 6 + 3 = 9 — the digits of any 9x answer always add up to 9
